intro.h2: Remodeling and repairs in Lincoln, NE, for projects big or small
paragraphs: A to Z Renovations & Improvements is a disabled-owned general contractor taking on remodeling and repairs in Lincoln, NE. The name fits the work. In our Google reviews you will find a tub and shower replacement, basement remodeling, an egress window, siding repairs and a proper well cover, all handled by the same crew.

What customers bring up most is Lee. They call him knowledgeable, clean, reliable and punctual, and say he goes above and beyond to get the details right. One homeowner says she can count on him for a big job or a small one. Another says his pricing was fair and competitive and he will be calling again.

services.h2: How we can help around the house

items.name: Tub and shower replacement
items.blurb: An old tub or a leaking shower can be swapped out quickly. One customer says Lee replaced a tub and shower in no time and kept him in the loop the whole way. We talk through what you want first, then get the bathroom back in service.

image.ai_prompt: Photorealistic photo of a newly installed white acrylic tub and shower combination with a clean white wall surround, chrome fixtures and a curved shower rod in a modest Midwestern home bathroom, warm sage accent towel, light gray vinyl floor, soft daylight, no people, no faces, no text, no logos, no brand names, 4:3
image.alt: Illustration of a new white tub and shower combination with chrome fixtures

items.name: Basement remodeling
items.blurb: Basements come up again and again in our reviews. Finishing a lower level gives you room for a family room, guest space or storage, and we can handle the framing, drywall and finish work involved. Ask about pairing it with an egress window.

image.ai_prompt: Photorealistic photo of a finished basement family room in a Nebraska home: light greige walls, wood-look vinyl plank floor, recessed ceiling lights, a window well letting in daylight through an egress window, a simple sectional sofa and a cedar-toned media console, warm and clean, no people, no faces, no text, no logos, no brand names, 4:3
image.alt: Illustration of a finished basement family room with plank flooring and an egress window

items.name: Egress windows and siding repair
items.blurb: One family says their new egress window looks great, and Lee also made sure two damaged pieces of siding were replaced and the well had the proper cover. Small exterior fixes like these keep water out and keep the house looking cared for.

image.ai_prompt: Photorealistic photo of the outside of a Lincoln, Nebraska ranch house with olive gray vinyl siding, a new basement egress window set in a corrugated metal window well with a clear well cover, fresh mulch and green lawn, bright summer daylight, no people, no faces, no text, no logos, no brand names, 4:3
image.alt: Illustration of a basement egress window with a clear well cover beside gray vinyl siding

items.name: Decks, porches and steps
items.blurb: We build outdoor steps and decks that are sturdy from the posts up. One job shown here is a new set of pressure-treated stairs with a landing and full railings for a side entry. Another photo shows a cedar-toned deck with cable railings around a lakeside sunroom.

image.alt: New pressure-treated wood stairs with a landing and spindle railings at the side door of a beige-sided home

why_choose_us.h2: Why Lincoln homeowners keep calling A to Z

items.title: Knowledge you can lean on
items.text: Knowledgeable staff is the top topic in our reviews. One customer puts it simply: Lee knows his stuff, and she would recommend him to anyone.

items.title: No job too small
items.text: Customers hire us for a single egress window or a run of odd projects over a few months. Each one gets the same care, down to two pieces of siding.

about.h2: About A to Z Renovations & Improvements
about.text: A to Z Renovations & Improvements is a disabled-owned general contractor working in Lincoln, NE. Lee is the person our customers know, and their reviews describe the same things again and again: he is knowledgeable, clean, reliable and willing to go above and beyond. Our work runs from bathrooms and basements to egress windows, siding, decks and steps, which is how we earned the name. Several customers came to us for one small fix and kept calling with more. We are available Monday through Saturday and closed on Sunday.

process.h2: How working with A to Z goes

steps.title: Give Lee a call
steps.text: Call (531) 333-1054 any day but Sunday and describe the job, whether it is a full bathroom or a single repair.

steps.title: Talk it through
steps.text: We look at the project with you, explain the options in plain terms and make sure we understand exactly what you want.

steps.title: Get an estimate
steps.text: You receive a clear estimate for the work before anything starts, so you can decide with all the facts in front of you.

steps.title: Do the work right
steps.text: The crew shows up when expected, keeps the site clean and takes care of the small details, like the right cover for a window well.

steps.title: Check it with you
steps.text: We walk through the finished work together and stay a phone call away for the next project on your list.

Would definitely recommend, very knowledgeable, friendly, and punctual. Thank you Lee!

items.name: Janean N.
items.text: Lee knows his stuff! He's clean. He's reliable and so very knowledgeable. I can count on him whether it be a big job or a small job. He's got me and I would recommend him to you, too.

I highly recommend A to Z for any home improvement projects big or small! I will definitely be calling next time I need anything done!

service_area.h2: Remodeling and repairs for Lincoln, NE homes
service_area.text: A to Z Renovations & Improvements serves homeowners in Lincoln, NE. Whether you need a basement finished, a new tub and shower, an egress window or a few boards of siding replaced, give us a call at (531) 333-1054. If you live just outside town, tell us where and what you need and we will let you know if we can get to you.

items.q: Do you take on small jobs?
items.a: Yes. Many of our customers start with something small, like an egress window, a siding repair or a well cover, and come back for more. One homeowner says she can count on Lee whether it is a big job or a small one, and that is how we like to work.

items.q: Can you replace my tub and shower?
items.a: Yes. Tub and shower replacement is one of the jobs our customers mention by name. One homeowner says Lee replaced his tub and shower in no time, explained everything along the way and charged a fair price. Call us to describe your bathroom and we will talk through the options.

Yes. Basement remodeling is one of the most common topics in our Google reviews. We can help turn an unfinished lower level into usable living space and can add an egress window so a basement room has a proper second way out and more daylight.

Our Google listing shows us open around the clock Monday through Saturday and closed on Sunday. Calling (531) 333-1054 is the quickest way to reach Lee. If he is on a job, leave a message with your name, address and the project and he will get back to you.

items.q: Is A to Z a disabled-owned business?
items.a: Yes. Our Google Business Profile identifies A to Z Renovations & Improvements as disabled-owned. We are a small, local contractor, and the people who answer the phone are the same people who show up to do the work at your house in Lincoln.

final_cta.h2: Got a project on your list?
final_cta.text: Call Lee at A to Z and tell us about it, from a new shower to a loose stair rail.
